title: Something wearing Dale

greeting.text: The bell over the door. A big man in a work shirt, rubbing his eyes with the heel of his hand.
Evening. Large flat white, and whatever diesel you'll let me have. Can't see my own bonnet out there.
Word for word. Even the pause. Last night you gave this man his coffee and watched his tail-lights go.

annoyed: Mate. I've shown you my hands.

notes.wrist: He taps his card and waits. Compare the left wrist with the right.
notes.reflection: Him from behind. Watch when he shifts his weight, and when the mirror does.
notes.shadow: One shadow. Soft. They got that part right.

topics.answer: Frozen peas to Mullane Flat. Should've been there by midnight.

topics.note: That was your line. He has it by heart.

topics.answer: He stopped for a bloke waving on the roadside. Good bloke. He always stopped.

wren.arrive: Look who's back. See? You were nice to him, and he came home.
wren.adviceLine: It's Dale. You served Dale last night. What's changed? ...Don't answer that. Serve him.

after.break: He was a nice one to wear. Shame.
after.serve: Same order, same pump. I do like a regular.

serve.text: Cheers. Keep that door locked between customers, yeah? I mean it.

turnAway.text: ...Righto. You were kinder last night. He remembered you being kind.

break.text: He said you were a good kid. That's why I came to you first.
It leaves the cap on the counter. There is still a head-shaped warmth in it.

report.serve: A B-double left Corrigan's westbound in the night. It is the same B-double that reached Mullane Flat yesterday. The depot says its driver has not left town.
report.turnAway: A man was seen walking west from Corrigan's on the centre line at a steady four kilometres an hour. He has not slowed down.
report.shelter: A truck driver in Mullane Flat rang us to say he dreamed he was in a storeroom. He wanted somebody to know.
report.break: A truck driver in Mullane Flat woke screaming at ten past two and could not say why.
report.missed: A B-double idled at Corrigan's pumps all night. Nobody was seen in the cab.
